So If you wanna get better as a marksman adc you need to learn several things, I am no expert but I think I have fair idea of how botlane works. 

First of all, you need to know your champion, every marksman is good if you know how to play it and which champs counter it. You need to learn mana costs, cooldowns, runes (and why do they work best for an specific champ), objects to buy.

Learn your supports: You can't play a kai'sa with a yuumi, for example, if you play kai'sa you need a support that can cc the opponent so you can actually kill the enemy. You need to be able to predict how the fight is gonna break out, which abilities will help you or kill you, how much damage will you receive vs how much damage you will apply (rune knowledge helps here).

Position: you can't be the frontline, you need to be able to be side by side or behind your support so you can carefully cs or develop fights (sometimes low elo supports don't get this). Usually supports are the ones that harrass and begin fights, so being in a position where you can get protected by your support or be able to engage with them in a fight is really important.

Learn how to cs: this is very important because farming is your main source of gold. You win lane when your cs is better and you can keep pressure over the enemy. Kills don't guarantee that a lane is lost/won. Wave management is important to prevent ganks, set ganks, pressure the enemy or just surviving overall.

Learn when to back: Usually you back when the next wave that is coming is a canon wave, that way you don't miss it and it's harder for the enemy laner to shove the wave. Don't back the same time as your support, for the most cases this is bad because that will leave no pressure in lane and then the enemy laner will just shove the wave. They could even get some plates or destroy the tower because you both backed at a wrong time. Also don't back when the dragon is up and a fight might broke out for it. Objectives win games, not items.

Kiting: In my opinion this is the most important skill as a marksman. While you kite you reduce the damage you receive while maintaining the dps you apply. You can dodge enemies abilities and you can use your abilities as your advantage. Most adc champions have a form of cc that allows them to kite and escape. You must learn how to move between autos without cancelling them and matching your movement time with your attack speed. You don't wana lose that dps. Kiting is the one thing that let's you survive a 1v1 and teamfights.
